svg.title: LeviMC — mod Bedrock your way
svg.desc: Animated portfolio of LeviMC (formerly LiteLDev): LeviLamina mod loader (1.7k stars, 3,108 commits, 133 releases), LegacyScriptEngine (JavaScript, Lua, Python), LeviLaunchroid and LeviLauncher (over a million release downloads), and the wider open-source ecosystem.

g.text: Lightweight, modular, versatile — the mod loader for Bedrock.
Native C++ performance, or the flexibility of scripts — same capabilities.
LeviLaunchroid for Android · LeviLauncher for Windows (GDK).
Everything around the loader — open source, LGPL-3.0.
Docker images · mod template · PreLoader · CrashLogger
C++ · JavaScript · Lua · Python · TypeScript · Java
OPEN SOURCE · BEDROCK MODDING · FORMERLY LITELDEV · SINCE 2021
Open source tools for the community, by the community.
